source_name: MNB – Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök (hub of supervisory regulatory instruments)
why_relevant: Canonical hub listing every soft-law supervisory instrument type MNB emits (ajánlás, vezetői körlevél, módszertani kézikönyv, mintaszabályzat, tájékoztató/útmutató, archívum). Single entry point for snowballing the whole A3 instrument family.

source_name: MNB Ajánlások (supervisory recommendations register)
why_relevant: Numbered MNB recommendations (e.g. 5/2023. (VI.23.), 26/2018. (VIII.16.) on payment service operational/security risk) each carry an explicit effective date (hatálybalépés) and addressee set — the core binding-by-supervision expectation layer for banks and PSPs.

source_name: MNB Vezetői körlevelek (executive circulars)
why_relevant: Targeted letters to named management circles enforcing a specific detail rule; typically the earliest and most operational signal of a supervisory expectation shift, often with short compliance deadlines.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti hírek / Hírek – újdonságok
why_relevant: Announcement stream that fires when a new ajánlás/körlevél/consultation appears ('Új MNB ajánlások megjelenése'), and relays EBA/ESA consultations MNB expects HU firms to follow. Best low-latency change-detection surface for the whole cell.

source_name: MNB RSS feeds (Felügyeleti hírek /rss/11, Piacfelügyelet /rss/23, Hírek /rss/5, Kiadványok /rss/7)
why_relevant: Machine-readable change feeds published by the emitting authority itself — the cheapest, most robust ingestion channel for supervisory/market-supervision announcements and new publications.

source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatói Portál (ASZP) – Adatszolgáltatási MNB rendeletek
why_relevant: Consolidated per-year register of MNB decrees governing supervisory reporting (e.g. 55/2021. (XI.23.), 57/2023. (XI.24.), 56/2024. (XII.3.)) with the technical guides. This is where reporting obligations and their submission deadlines are legally fixed.

source_name: MNB ASZP – Rendelettervezetek (draft reporting decrees / consultation)
why_relevant: Pre-publication drafts of MNB reporting decrees — the earliest lawful forward signal of upcoming reporting obligations and their entry-into-force dates, typically 3-9 months before Magyar Közlöny promulgation. High-value for anticipating vendor/IT workload.

source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatás – Hitelintézetek (sector reporting pages, per year)
why_relevant: Year-by-year credit institution reporting packages plus ad-hoc/extraordinary data requests (rendkívüli adatszolgáltatás) with explicit submission deadlines (e.g. L74 monthly by the 15th working day). Directly encodes supervisory deadline load.

source_name: MNB Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions & fines search)
why_relevant: Searchable register of licensing, enforcement, market-supervision and consumer-protection decisions across money market / insurance / capital market / pension sectors. Supervisory findings revealed as enforcement outcomes — the ground truth on what MNB actually punishes, incl. payments and IT/AML failings.

source_name: MNB Ellenőrzési terv és jelentés (annual supervisory examination plan & report)
why_relevant: Forward-looking annual plan of which institutions/themes MNB will inspect — a calendar of supervisory attention, and the single best predictor of where findings and remediation spend will land next year.

source_name: MNB mint pénzforgalmi hatóság – Pénzforgalmi ellenőrzés + Kiemelt vizsgálati szempontok
why_relevant: MNB's payments-authority arm (Pft. 2009/LXXXV.): publishes the uniform inspection criteria and the 'kiemelt vizsgálati szempontok' (priority examination points) applied to PSPs, plus the statutory 3-year inspection cycle. Directly names payments compliance topics under scrutiny.

source_name: MNB Informatikai felügyelet (IT supervision)
why_relevant: MNB's IT/ICT supervisory expectations for banks and PSPs (cloud outsourcing FAQ, ICT risk, DORA-adjacent guidance). Highly relevant for payments-technology vendors: this is where MNB states what infrastructure choices are acceptable.

source_name: MNB Jogszabályok (legislation index for supervised sectors)
why_relevant: MNB's own curated index of the acts and decrees (Hpt., Pft., Bszt., MNB tv., MNB rendeletek) applicable to supervised institutions — the authoritative mapping from MNB instrument to underlying legal base.

source_name: MNB Zöld Pénzügyek portal – felügyeleti eszközök (green recommendations & circulars)
why_relevant: Separate MNB subdomain carrying green-themed ajánlások and vezetői körlevelek that do not always surface on the main felügyelet hub — a coverage hole if only mnb.hu/felugyelet is crawled.

source_name: MNB English supervision/regulation mirror – Tools of supervisory regulation
why_relevant: English mirror of the instrument hub, useful for cross-checking terminology and for items MNB chooses to publish in EN. Coverage is partial — MNB itself notes recommendations are available in Hungarian — so EN must never be the only crawl.

source_name: MNB Supervisory Disclosure (CRD IV) – Rules and Guidance
why_relevant: EU-mandated supervisory disclosure tables mapping Hungarian transposition of CRD/CRR options and national discretions — a structured, comparable view of HU prudential rules that is maintained on a fixed EBA-driven cadence.

source_name: MNB Fizetési rendszer jelentés (Payment Systems Report)
why_relevant: Annual MNB report (published since 2012) on domestic payment trends, oversight of payment/securities settlement systems and risks; frequently pre-announces regulatory intentions (instant payments, fraud measures) before instruments are issued.

source_name: MNB Engedélyezés – MNB ajánlások / engedélyezési útmutatók (licensing guidance incl. payment institutions)
why_relevant: Licensing-side view of applicable recommendations plus procedural guides such as 'Pénzforgalmi intézmények tevékenységének engedélyezése' — defines documentation and deadline expectations for new payment-institution entrants.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök archívuma + mnb.hu/archivum (legacy PSZÁF-era instruments)
why_relevant: Historical ajánlások/vezetői körlevelek (including PSZÁF legacy) needed to establish baselines and to tell 'withdrawn' from 'never existed' when a current instrument disappears from the live listing.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.hu) – consolidated MNB rendelet texts
why_relevant: Official consolidated legal text of MNB decrees with in-force dates and amendment history. MNB's own pages give the instrument; njt gives the authoritative hatályos version and amendment timeline needed for deadline tracking.

source_name: MNB Szanálás – Szabályozás és Határozatok (resolution authority arm)
why_relevant: MNB also acts as national resolution authority; publishes its own regulation set and resolution decisions, a distinct instrument stream from the prudential/payments hubs and easy to miss.

source_name: Big-4 / law-firm MNB regulatory alerts (e.g. KPMG Hungary insights)
why_relevant: Advisory firms publish rapid EN-language summaries of MNB executive circulars and recommendations, often with practical deadline read-outs. Useful as a cross-check and EN-language discovery channel, never as the primary record.

source_name: Magyar Közlöny (Magyarország hivatalos lapja) — official gazette portal
why_relevant: The constitutionally authoritative point of promulgation for every Hungarian törvény, kormányrendelet, miniszteri rendelet and MNB rendelet. Any statutory obligation or transposition deadline affecting banks and PSPs becomes binding only on publication here, and the issue date drives hatálybalépés (entry-into-force) arithmetic. Authentic digitally signed PDFs since 3 May 2013.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (NJT) — official consolidated law database
why_relevant: The state-operated free consolidated ('hatályos', 'időállapot') text database run by MKIFK Magyar Közlönykiadó és Igazságügyi Fordítóközpont Zrt. Gives the point-in-time consolidated version of Hpt., Pft., Mnbtv., and every MNB/Korm./miniszteri rendelet, with colour-coded status (in force / repealed / not yet in force) and effective-date ranges — exactly the structure a compliance calendar needs. Also hosts indokolások (explanatory memoranda), international treaties, and English translations.

source_name: NJT indokolástár (repository of statutory explanatory memoranda)
why_relevant: Indokolás (explanatory memorandum) texts state legislative intent and, crucially for A3, name the EU directive being transposed and the reasoning behind chosen transition periods. This is where a compliance calendar gets the 'why' and the EU linkage for a Hungarian deadline.

source_name: Hpt. — 2013. évi CCXXXVII. törvény a hitelintézetekről és a pénzügyi vállalkozásokról (Credit Institutions Act), consolidated
why_relevant: The core prudential statute for Hungarian banks — licensing, own funds, governance, outsourcing, disclosure, sanctions. Almost every CRD/CRR-package transposition and every domestic banking obligation lands as an Hpt. amendment, so tracking Hpt. módosítások is the single highest-yield statutory tracker for the banking half of the cell.

source_name: Pft. — 2009. évi LXXXV. törvény a pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás nyújtásáról (Payment Services Act), consolidated
why_relevant: The Hungarian payment-services act — the PSD2 transposition vehicle and the statute defining pénzforgalmi szolgáltató categories, SCA-adjacent duties, liability and information obligations. It is the act that PSD3 will amend or replace, so it is the anchor document for the payments half of the cell and for any PSD3 transposition deadline.
